title: Party Bike Pub Crawl in Deep Ellum and Downtown Dallas
includes: Pickup and drop-off from designated meeting points
Food and drinks, unless specified (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Minimum of six passengers required for the tour to operate, in order for it to be comfortable to pedal. There is a possibility of cancellation after confirmation if there are not enough passengers to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, you will be offered an alternative or full refund. We will let you know if there are changes at least 24 hours in advance
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Book from six to fifteen seats on our pedal pub crawl extravaganza, where your certified party bike pilot will take you and your merry band of imbibing companions to three of the best Dallas bar crawl stops in Deep Ellum, complete with VIP drink specials at each of our partner bars! And with BYO legal on our buzz bike, all eyes will be on you as you're raising your cans and solo cups while pedaling and partying at the best that Dallas has to offer!
